name: Frank Pallone
stance: Calls for enforceable federal AI safety standards to prevent catastrophic consequences rather than voluntary commitments, and with committee colleagues asked frontier AI companies to report safety incidents to Congress.

statements.text: Called on Energy and Commerce Committee Republicans to join Democrats in putting AI safety guardrails and enforcement in place.
If you’re puzzled as to why Trump isn’t calling for frontier AI guardrails after industry experts warned of existential risks—this could be why.
He’d rather give a blank check to his big tech billionaire friends than make sure the most transformative technology of the century—perhaps in history—works for humanity's benefit.
We need federal safety standards that are enforceable to prevent catastrophic consequences, not voluntary promises.

Dozens of AI safety incidents have come to light in recent months, with thousands more under investigation. We can’t count on the Trump Administration to act, so I’m working with @RepZoeLofgren and @RepRaskin to ask AI companies to report incidents to Congress.
